headline: Not confirmed for Sunday 1 November 2026
detail: Apps Court Farm's car boot page has not yet said whether there is a sale on Sunday 1 November 2026. Its notice still reads "THE CAR BOOT IS CLOSED THIS SUNDAY THE 25TH", which refers to last Sunday, 25 October. Sales are weather dependent and the farm posts each week's notice at the top of its own car boot page, so check Apps Court Farm's car boot page or call 01932 244 822 for the recorded message before travelling. When a sale is on, gates open at 7am for sellers and buyers, it closes at 1pm, sellers just turn up, and buyer parking is £2, collected on the way out. The farm's own FAQ limits the season to "every Sunday from early March, through to the Autumn", so late-autumn and winter Sundays are not guaranteed even in good weather.
